start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:hire-help-for-a-step: I need someone to photograph the shelf at Example Market on 12 Example Street on Saturday at 10:00, and the proof I want is three photos of the shelf."
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: one waiting row goes on the person's Waiting on you list, and the booking and proof are kept on the run record.
instructions: 1. Say what must be done in person (step), and where, when and what proof you want (where, when, proof_wanted); only step is required.
2. Say "Run workflow:hire-help-for-a-step". The AI writes the task as a tasker reads it, finds who can do it near you and the total price.
3. One row appears on your Waiting on you list with the task, who and the price. Press it to book; nothing is booked or emailed before that tap.
4. After the tap it books or emails, puts the time on your calendar with tool:hold-to-it, and checks the proof arrived, following up and telling you if it did not.
